conclusion: evidence_risk is the only ESSENTIAL component and is load-bearing for left-tail control: removing it produces the largest mean deterioration (-3.249), the most negative median spread (-2.9845), and a +11.11% stop-rate degradation with cvar_delta -0.7478 across 12 confirmation weeks. distinct1 (cvar_delta -2.3401 when removed, confirming the requirement to keep it) and freshness (cvar_delta -1.0231, stop-rate -2.78% when added back) form a secondary downside-protection layer that is HELPFUL but not standalone-load-bearing. The mechanism map shows a hierarchy in which evidence_risk gates the system and distinct1+freshness refine it; all volume/lane/eps components are either UNCERTAIN or HELPFUL only at the margin and cannot substitute for the risk gate. B0 is retained not because it dominates, but because no frozen B1, single-rule repair, or pre-screened variant satisfied the pre-registered gates — this is a 'no-coherent-better-policy found' state, not an 'unbeatable B0' claim.
strongest_evidence: evidence_risk knockout yields confirmation_cvar_delta -0.7478, confirmation_mean_spread -3.249, confirmation_median_spread -2.9845, and confirmation_stop_delta_pct +11.11% with positive_block_ratio 0.0 — the only component hitting ESSENTIAL on all four risk/return axes simultaneously.

distinct1 knockout yields confirmation_cvar_delta -2.3401 (the largest single-component cvar penalty in the map), confirming distinct1 is required when evidence_risk is held constant — i.e., the two are complementary, not redundant.

freshness knockout yields confirmation_cvar_delta -1.0231 and confirmation_risk_noninferior=false with confirmation_one_pick_ruins_delta_pct -8.33%, supplying directional evidence that freshness improves downside without materially adding return (mean_spread +0.0254 only).

downside_distress_hard_gate (agent B1) confirmation gives full_top3_rate_pct 100%, slot_coverage_pct 100%, cvar_delta +3.7332, mean_spread +1.2787, jaccard_vs_b0 0.7, risk_noninferior=true — indicating the mechanism is implementable and non-degrading on the locked confirmation window even though it failed the pre-screened B1 gate.

Volume components (dry_false_penalty, weekly_volume, entry_volume) all show knockout confirmation = 0 across cvar/mean/median/stops — i.e., null evidence of marginal contribution in this 12-week window, justifying UNCERTAIN rather than HELPFUL.
contradictions: Most acute: downside_distress_hard_gate (agent B1) has screen_mean -1.1963 (below B0, with screen_cvar_delta -1.3633 and screen_stop_delta_pct -5.56%) yet confirmation_mean +1.2787, confirmation_cvar_delta +3.7332, risk_noninferior=true, full_top3_rate 100%. The screen and confirmation are pointing in opposite directions; the policy failed b1_gate_pass despite confirmation-stage superiority on every metric except the pre-registered gate. Either the screen protocol is mis-calibrated for this family, or confirmation results over-fit to FWD_5/FWD_6 block structure (cvar contribution is entirely from those two blocks; FWD_1-FWD_4 were zero). This is a direct conflict between pre-registered decision rule and observed confirmation evidence.

lane is HELPFUL at the component level (knockout_cvar_delta 0.0 but confirmation_mean_spread +0.0788 with positive_block_ratio 0.25 and stop_delta +5.55%), yet the lane-knockout forward policy shows pooled_mean_spread -2.3545 with pooled_ci_low -7.4673 and screen_mean -7.221 — driven almost entirely by FWD_2 (pooled_mean_spread -14.442). The block concentration implies lane's HELPFUL verdict is dominated by a single adverse block rather than a stable mechanism, which contradicts the implicit assumption that HELPFUL implies uniform marginal benefit.

distinct1 vs evidence_risk ranking ambiguity: distinct1 shows a larger cvar penalty (-2.3401) when knocked out than evidence_risk (-0.7478) does on the same axis, yet evidence_risk is the only ESSENTIAL. This indicates the verdict rubric weights stop-rate and mean spread more than raw cvar magnitude — and therefore the ordering of component importance depends on the rubric, not on raw economic damage. A skeptic cannot conclude evidence_risk is 'more important' than distinct1 from the magnitudes alone.

freshness is HELPFUL with stop_delta -2.78% (beneficial) and cvar_delta -1.0231 (beneficial), but its confirmation_one_pick_ruins_delta_pct is -8.33% (negative — opposite sign from the direction the rubric would expect for a HELPFUL component), and risk_noninferior=false. HELPFUL verdict co-exists with non-inferiority failure.

eps_preference is UNCERTAIN (mean +0.0723, cvar 0, stop 0) but jaccard_vs_b0 = 0.9583 and slot_coverage 100% with full_top3 100% — meaning eps_preference has near-zero marginal effect yet has near-zero churn. The combination of 'uncertain utility' and 'high stability' contradicts any narrative that the component is harmful.
unresolved: Is the FWD_5/FWD_6 cvar contribution in downside_distress_hard_gate (+3.7332 and +6.9574) a robust regime signal or a block-specific artifact? A concentrated single-window cvar gain needs a forward shadow to test whether the policy retains its left-tail advantage when those two blocks are no longer in-sample. Pre-register: confirm over a forward window where FWD_5/FWD_6-style conditions are absent.

Does evidence_risk remain ESSENTIAL when tested against fresh distractor names (non-distinct1 substitutes)? The component map holds distinct1 constant in the evidence_risk knockout but does not isolate evidence_risk | distinct1 | freshness as a triplet vs evidence_risk alone. Forward shadow: pre-register a single-rule repair that retains evidence_risk only and measure CVaR degradation vs the B0 baseline.

Screen-vs-confirmation divergence: screen_mean -1.1963 → confirmation_mean +1.2787 for the agent policy. Is the 6-week screen protocol statistically adequate to triage mechanism-class B1 candidates, or does it systematically reject the policies that would have helped? A paired screen+confirmation forward study with screen re-run on confirmation-quality data would address this.
